e26eceba-9c07-4407-8309-b73fb350a5d3/Eve.en: "Yes...<NL>I have known the 'Taiwu' for over three hundred years.<NL>But... although I know you, not all of you necessarily know me.<NL>Those like you, who can reach the Realm of Selflessness and meet me, are extremely rare..."<NL>Huanxin pauses here, suddenly hesitant, and can't help but size up <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, her brow furrowing...
e26eceba-9c07-4407-8309-b73fb350a5d3/Eve.cn: “是呀……<NL>我与‘太吾’相识，已有三百余年，<NL>只是……我虽识得你们，你们却未必个个都识得我，<NL>如你这般，能至无我之境，与我相见的，原是极少……”<NL>焕心说到这里，突然有些迟疑，不由得打量起<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，眉头亦随之皱起……

7a8dc0c9-56d0-4c0b-a1cf-60234cddc036/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> barely escapes from <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>'s grasp...
7a8dc0c9-56d0-4c0b-a1cf-60234cddc036/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>艰难地从<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>手中逃脱了……
7a8dc0c9-56d0-4c0b-a1cf-60234cddc036/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> едва спасается от <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>его хватка...

21f1bcc1-de99-4440-9ddb-fe4949ba3d18/Eve.en: Deep in the mist-shrouded forest, the path twists and turns...<NL><NL>Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> pushes through dense branches and leaves to make a small forest trail,<NL>a strong wind suddenly sweeps a thick bank of clouds right into his face. Unexpectedly...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finds himself atop a sheer cliff a thousand fathoms high!<NL><NL>A young girl stands at the edge of the cliff,<NL>leisurely stretching one bare foot out into the sea of clouds...
21f1bcc1-de99-4440-9ddb-fe4949ba3d18/Eve.cn: 雾罩林深处，峰回路转时……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />正拨开繁密的树木枝叶，走出一条林中小道之时，<NL>一阵大风，忽然裹着大片云雾迎面扑来，不想……<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />却是走到了一座万丈悬崖之上！<NL><NL>一个女孩儿，正站在悬崖边上，<NL>优哉游哉地往云海里凌空伸出一只脚丫……

21f1bcc1-de99-4440-9ddb-fe4949ba3d18/Opt.en: The cliff is dangerous! Don't be reckless!

997c1dbc-deb4-4fa2-9554-fde6703e1556/Eve.en: Then, towering waves surge...<NL>A figure slowly flies over, riding on the glow of dawn...
997c1dbc-deb4-4fa2-9554-fde6703e1556/Eve.cn: 紧接着，巨浪滔天……<NL>一个人影随之缓缓地乘着霞光飞来……
997c1dbc-deb4-4fa2-9554-fde6703e1556/Eve.ru: Затем вздымаются высокие волны...<NL>Фигура медленно пролетает над нами, оседлав сияние рассвета...

27aa001f-5080-46c2-8353-02dc071eed01/Eve.en: "Such persistence... could it be that I am hindered by you?"<NL>The person repeats the same pattern, but although the words learned differ by only one character from what <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> said,<NL>the meaning is completely different...
27aa001f-5080-46c2-8353-02dc071eed01/Eve.cn: “如此纠缠，莫不是我受了你的阻碍？”<NL>那人再又依样说来，但所学之话，虽与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />所言仅一字之差，<NL>意思却已全然不同……
27aa001f-5080-46c2-8353-02dc071eed01/Eve.ru: - Такая настойчивость... может ли быть так, что ты мне мешаешь?"<NL>Человек повторяет один и тот же шаблон, но, хотя выученные слова отличаются только одним символом от того, что он говорит. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> сказал,<NL>смысл совершенно другой...

27aa001f-5080-46c2-8353-02dc071eed01/Opt.en: What a fiendish demon, twisting right and wrong! Truly shameless!
27aa001f-5080-46c2-8353-02dc071eed01/Opt.cn: 好个妖魔，颠倒是非，当真无耻！
27aa001f-5080-46c2-8353-02dc071eed01/Opt.ru: Что за дьявольский демон, изворачивающийся между добром и злом! Поистине бесстыдный!

50def534-213b-43fc-8400-7991f173af15/Eve.en: After a long time...<NL>a piercing pain awakens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> struggles to open their eyes, only to find themselves lying amidst a pile of rubble.<NL>An invisible malice aura blocks all life from entering...
50def534-213b-43fc-8400-7991f173af15/Eve.cn: 许久之后……<NL>一阵刺骨的疼痛将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />唤醒，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />挣扎着睁开双眼，发现自己正置身一片乱石堆中，<NL>一道无形的煞气将一切生气阻隔于外……
50def534-213b-43fc-8400-7991f173af15/Eve.ru: Спустя долгое время...<NL>пробуждается пронзительная боль <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> изо всех сил пытаются открыть глаза только для того, чтобы обнаружить себя лежащими среди груды обломков.<NL>Невидимая аура злобы блокирует проникновение всего живого...

0d112e4d-f32d-43ea-ac7b-fafafac71980/Eve.en: Dark clouds turn to shadows, black flames become robes!<NL>The demon reveals its true form! Evil as a purgatory Asura, fierce as an extraterrestrial deity!<NL>What a Xiangshu! Feet like a lion, treading upon the blood of countless living beings; hands like an elephant, curling back eight Mara arrows!<NL>On its face grow twelve strange eyes, each one taking in the three thousand worlds at a glance...
0d112e4d-f32d-43ea-ac7b-fafafac71980/Eve.cn: 乌云化影，黑焰作衣！<NL>妖魔现出真身来！恶似炼狱修罗，凶比天外鬼神！<NL>好个相枢！足似狮，踏着万千生灵血，手似象，倒卷八支摩罗箭！<NL>面上更生十二只怪目，各将三千世界收于眼底……

0d112e4d-f32d-43ea-ac7b-fafafac71980/Opt.en: Swore to see divine edges ever hone! For if Xiangshu remained... the mortal realm would be doomed!
0d112e4d-f32d-43ea-ac7b-fafafac71980/Opt.cn: 誓要神锋消磨尽！不灭相枢……无人间！
0d112e4d-f32d-43ea-ac7b-fafafac71980/Opt.ru: Поклялся, что увижу, как божественные грани когда-нибудь отточатся! Ибо, если бы Сяншу остался... царство смертных было бы обречено!

9914c20c-bbae-4d2e-8c57-56731329cb6f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> opens their eyes and rises to look around,<NL>but sees only emptiness—there's no sign of Immortal Xu at all.<NL><NL>When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks back, they discover they are still sitting quietly in place.<NL>It turns out that, unnoticed, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> had entered a state of Soul Egression and arrived within an illusionary realm...
9914c20c-bbae-4d2e-8c57-56731329cb6f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />睁开双眼，起身来看，<NL>却见四周空空荡荡，哪里寻得见徐仙公的踪影？<NL><NL>待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />回头一望，却看见自己仍静坐在原地，<NL>原来，不知不觉间，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />已出神脱世，来到了幻境之中……

7083c5ee-33d7-488c-aaba-3e75f9531110/Eve.en: After a long time...<NL>a piercing pain awakens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> struggles to open their eyes, only to be dazzled by the intermittent flashes of golden light surrounding them...
7083c5ee-33d7-488c-aaba-3e75f9531110/Eve.cn: 许久之后……<NL>一阵刺骨的疼痛将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />唤醒，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />挣扎着睁开双眼，却被四周不时闪烁的金光眩晕了脑袋……

5ab30844-a756-4e5c-b5df-4eb88cbf11aa/Eve.cn: “「太吾」、焕心……<NL>你们……这便随本座去吧！”

65a9b27d-4c39-46e7-bd50-3c894e03a472/Eve.en: After a long time...<NL>a piercing pain awakens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> struggles to open their eyes, only to find the flora, rocks, and mountains nearby flickering in and out of existence,<NL>sometimes appearing ahead, sometimes behind...
65a9b27d-4c39-46e7-bd50-3c894e03a472/Eve.cn: 许久之后……<NL>一阵刺骨的疼痛将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />唤醒，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />挣扎着睁开双眼，却发现身旁的草木山石皆忽隐忽现，<NL>时而在前，时而在后……
65a9b27d-4c39-46e7-bd50-3c894e03a472/Eve.ru: Спустя долгое время...<NL>пробуждается пронзительная боль <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> изо всех сил пытаясь открыть глаза, они обнаруживают, что флора, скалы и горы поблизости то появляются, то исчезают,<NL>иногда появляющийся впереди, иногда позади...

e69a1c0a-fd27-40be-b4ee-bd24b327a594/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has defeated Wei Qi!<NL><NL>Wei Qi falls backward, crashing heavily into the mud.<NL>"I see... what Master said about sacrificing oneself for righteousness... I think I understand..."<NL>As Wei Qi dissolves into the mud, he says, "Severing life for righteousness is not true virtue; only by entering the mud can one achieve the Tao..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Obtained <ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>...)</color>
e69a1c0a-fd27-40be-b4ee-bd24b327a594/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />击败了卫起！<NL><NL>卫起仰天而倒，重重地摔在了污泥当中，<NL>“是了……师父说的舍身取义……我好像懂了……”<NL>卫起边消融在污泥中边说道：“断命求义非真义，入得污泥方成道……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（获得<ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>……）</color>

8768c0bb-0d51-4d91-adcc-af623ff2ddd4/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has defeated Monu!<NL><NL>Just as Monu lies prostrate on the ground, a sparrow suddenly lands by her ear and chirps softly.<NL>"So... it has been delivered after all..." Monu seems to understand the sparrow's words.<NL>Finally, she smiles, sighs softly, and turns into a wisp of green smoke, vanishing into the sky...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Obtained <ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>...)</color>
8768c0bb-0d51-4d91-adcc-af623ff2ddd4/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />击败了莫女！<NL><NL>正当莫女伏倒在地之时，一只麻雀突然落在她的耳边，叽喳轻语起来，<NL>“原来，已送到了吗……”莫女似乎听懂了麻雀的话语，<NL>终于面露微笑，轻叹一声，化作一缕青烟消失在了天际……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（获得<ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>……）</color>

664b0ee7-35ba-4251-b279-da6ba548e969/Eve.en: "What a demon, heh, twisting... hehe...<NL>right and wrong... hehehe... truly... hehehehe... shameless..."<NL>The person's face darkens, yet they suddenly burst into laughter. Without warning, they lunge forward, striking straight at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!
664b0ee7-35ba-4251-b279-da6ba548e969/Eve.cn: “好个妖魔，嘿，颠倒……嘿嘿……<NL>是非……嘿嘿嘿……当真……嘿嘿嘿嘿……无耻……”<NL>那人脸色一沉，反而笑出声来，突然欺身而上，竟向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />迎面袭来！
664b0ee7-35ba-4251-b279-da6ba548e969/Eve.ru: - Что за демон, хех, изворачивается... хе-хе...<NL>правильное и неправильное... хе-хе-хе... действительно... хе-хе-хе... бесстыдница..."<NL>Лицо человека мрачнеет, но он внезапно разражается смехом. Без предупреждения они бросаются вперед, нанося удары прямо в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!

b343ed7a-c3e1-4f93-9ddb-6d82e8969e4b/Eve.en: In an instant, a dazzling white light bursts forth from the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Hilt</color>!<NL><NL>Within the white light, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> sees a divine sword slice across the sky, fly into the mortal world, and then...<NL>Heroes wield it to punish evil; lovers lean on it to share eternal slumber;<NL>generals rely on it to break enemy formations; children offer it to the emperor...
b343ed7a-c3e1-4f93-9ddb-6d82e8969e4b/Eve.cn: 霎时间，一道炫目的白光自<color=#yellow>「伏虞剑柄」</color>上迸发出来！<NL><NL>白光之中，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />见到一柄神剑划破长空，飞入尘世，而后……<NL>英雄执之尽惩奸，儿女倚之共长眠，<NL>将军仗之破敌阵，小儿捧之献御前……

8aadff38-c0a2-454d-8052-2b4da4344bc1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has defeated Yi Xiang!<NL><NL>"Jade dies, jade dies—Xirang is no true soul.<NL>Jade dies, jade dies—children must finally see their elders.<NL>Jade dies, jade dies—ah dear... outmatched, nowhere to hide..."<NL>Yi Xiang sings and sighs. When the song ends, he scatters into countless jade beads, all burrowing into the earth...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Obtained <ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>...)</color>
8aadff38-c0a2-454d-8052-2b4da4344bc1/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />击败了以向！<NL><NL>“玉死，玉死，息壤作魂不是魂，<NL>玉死，玉死，孩童终要见大人，<NL>玉死，玉死，哎哟……技不如人无处隐……”<NL>以向边唱边叹，待到歌声一止，他终于散落成了无数玉珠，纷纷遁入了地底……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（获得<ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>……）</color>

36d1171e-a8db-41ba-920b-0f6e3c11a18b/Eve.en: After another moment,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> endures the pain and looks up again,<NL>only to see two small peach trees, one tall and one short, materializing before their eyes...<NL>Around the peach trees, many white-furred foxes dart up and down, occasionally casting wary glances at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...
36d1171e-a8db-41ba-920b-0f6e3c11a18b/Eve.cn: 又过片刻，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />强忍疼痛，举目再看，<NL>却见两棵细小的桃树一高一矮地在眼前显示出来……<NL>在桃树的四周，许多白毛狐狸正上下游窜，不时向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />投来警惕的目光……

8ea8154f-ae2b-452b-8889-832ca3bb83cc/Eve.en: Performing the Art of Soul Egression is fraught with peril!<NL>Both favorable timing and advantageous terrain are indispensable. The slightest error will inevitably lead to the scattering of the soul and eternal damnation.<NL>However, if the time and place are both perfect, and aided by a divine artifact to guard the essence and a spirit to provide guidance, the art becomes exceedingly easy to perform.<NL>Just focus, sit still, and let nature take its course...
8ea8154f-ae2b-452b-8889-832ca3bb83cc/Eve.cn: 行出神之法，最是凶险！<NL>天时、地利皆不可缺，倘若稍有差池，难免魂飞魄散，永不超生，<NL>但倘若时机、地点皆宜，又得神物守元，魂灵召引，却又极易施为，<NL>只需凝神静坐，顺其自然……

8ea8154f-ae2b-452b-8889-832ca3bb83cc/Opt.en: (Holding the Fuyu Hilt, sit in meditation on the spot to enter a trance...)
8ea8154f-ae2b-452b-8889-832ca3bb83cc/Opt.cn: （手持伏虞剑柄，就地凝神入定……）
8ea8154f-ae2b-452b-8889-832ca3bb83cc/Opt.ru: (Держа Рукоять Фую, сядьте в медитации на месте, чтобы войти в транс...)

9c35f4ef-c15d-4bc5-ab0d-49ccef41380b/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> is struck in a vital spot and falls into a pool of blood...
9c35f4ef-c15d-4bc5-ab0d-49ccef41380b/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />被击中了要害，倒在了血泊之中……
9c35f4ef-c15d-4bc5-ab0d-49ccef41380b/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> получает удар в жизненно важное место и падает в лужу крови...

28d1eade-99c3-4231-8b1b-6c437a1715f3/Eve.en: After another moment,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> endures the pain and looks up again,<NL>only to discover that everything around them is carved from jade, appearing almost transparent...<NL>The flora, rocks, and mountains flickering beside <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> seem to emit childish giggles...
28d1eade-99c3-4231-8b1b-6c437a1715f3/Eve.cn: 又过片刻，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />强忍疼痛，举目再看，<NL>发现周边的一切竟都是以玉石雕砌而成，望之好似透明……<NL>那些在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />身旁隐现不定的草木山石，似乎纷纷发出孩童般的嬉笑声……

d99a3d1d-807c-4806-b8f0-b114c11fa580/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> opens his mouth to speak,<NL>but their mind suddenly goes blank. They cannot even recall their own name...
d99a3d1d-807c-4806-b8f0-b114c11fa580/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />话到嘴边，<NL>脑中突然一空，竟然想不起自己的姓名了……
d99a3d1d-807c-4806-b8f0-b114c11fa580/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> открывает рот, чтобы заговорить,<NL>но в их голове внезапно становится пусто. Они даже не могут вспомнить свое собственное имя...

378c3964-2ed0-421f-9c77-26f16eb1a230/Eve.en: Then, all things dissolve.<NL>The beach sinks into crimson ashes dotted with strange black stones.<NL>Corpses with grim, terrifying expressions appear all around, interwoven with the strange stones and ashes into a vision of hell,<NL>assaulting <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s eyes directly...
378c3964-2ed0-421f-9c77-26f16eb1a230/Eve.cn: 随后，万物消解，<NL>海滩沉入了一片长着玄色怪石的殷红灰烬之中，<NL>一具又一具死状狰狞的尸体也在周围显现出来，与怪石、灰烬交织成一幅炼狱景象，<NL>直闯入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的眼帘……
378c3964-2ed0-421f-9c77-26f16eb1a230/Eve.ru: Тогда все вещи растворяются.<NL>Пляж погружается в багровый пепел, усеянный странными черными камнями.<NL>Повсюду появляются трупы с мрачными, наводящими ужас выражениями лиц, переплетающиеся со странными камнями и пеплом, создавая видение ада,<NL>нападающий <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />прямо в глаза...

378c3964-2ed0-421f-9c77-26f16eb1a230/Opt.en: Blackstone LandThis place... is already the Land of Blackstones?!

4cf053de-1be6-412c-926d-e035c74b13a0/Eve.en: "In the end... 'I'... won..."<NL>The person lies on the ground, gasping for breath, still babbling nonsense.<NL>Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> wants to step forward to investigate what kind of monster they are, the person scatters into a pile of dust...
4cf053de-1be6-412c-926d-e035c74b13a0/Eve.cn: “终是……‘我’……胜了……”<NL>那人倒在地上，气息奄奄，口中仍只有胡言乱语，<NL>正当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />想要上前查明其究竟是何方妖怪时，那人却已散作了一堆砂尘……
4cf053de-1be6-412c-926d-e035c74b13a0/Eve.ru: "В конце концов... "Я"... победил..."<NL>Человек лежит на земле, хватая ртом воздух, все еще бормоча какую-то чушь.<NL>Точно так же, как <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> желая сделать шаг вперед, чтобы выяснить, что это за монстр, человек превращается в кучку пыли...

52c23052-52ce-4450-ad4d-e84a16db2c9c/Eve.en: "You are nothing but a featherless bird mimicking humans, parroting words and clumsily imitating a tiger!"<NL>The person repeats the same pattern, but although the words learned differ by only one character from what <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> said,<NL>the meaning is completely different...
52c23052-52ce-4450-ad4d-e84a16db2c9c/Eve.cn: “你乃十足秃毛鸟人，向人学舌，照虎画猫！”<NL>那人再又依样说来，但所学之话，虽与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />所言仅一字之差，<NL>意思却已全然不同……

52c23052-52ce-4450-ad4d-e84a16db2c9c/Opt.en: What a fiendish demon, twisting right and wrong! Truly shameless!
52c23052-52ce-4450-ad4d-e84a16db2c9c/Opt.cn: 好个妖魔，颠倒是非，当真无耻！
52c23052-52ce-4450-ad4d-e84a16db2c9c/Opt.ru: Что за дьявольский демон, изворачивающийся между добром и злом! Поистине бесстыдный!

6f63ac5a-bd1e-4a1e-8962-637a16dd3e6d/Eve.en: "That 'sword'... having been here with me,<NL>has endured... immense suffering for ages.<NL>You... actually... managed to... rescue it and pacify its heart..."<NL>An extremely faint voice emanates from a massive piece of blackstone...
6f63ac5a-bd1e-4a1e-8962-637a16dd3e6d/Eve.cn: “那‘剑’……同我在此，<NL>已受了……许久许久的苦，<NL>你……竟……能……将其解救，归化其心……”<NL>一个极其微弱的声音，从一块巨大的玄石处传来……
6f63ac5a-bd1e-4a1e-8962-637a16dd3e6d/Eve.ru: - Этот "Меч"... побывав здесь со мной,<NL>веками терпел... безмерные страдания.<NL>Ты... на самом деле... сумел... спасти его и успокоить его сердце..."<NL>Чрезвычайно слабый голос исходит из массивного куска черного камня...

17c9b224-e778-40da-aca1-626fdf2d0427/Eve.en: After another moment,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> endures the pain and looks up again.<NL>The flock of birds circling above the pool has not yet dispersed, but they gradually quiet down...<NL>More and more birds alight around <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, tilting their heads and watching <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, as if expecting something?
17c9b224-e778-40da-aca1-626fdf2d0427/Eve.cn: 又过片刻，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />强忍疼痛，举目再看，<NL>在水潭上方盘旋的鸟群虽仍未散去，却渐渐地安静了下来……<NL>越来越多的鸟儿停歇在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的四周，歪头注视着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，似乎在期待些什么？

580a61f7-0250-42a2-9faa-4c3910b3ae9f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> follows the voice and<NL>quickly reaches the huge blackstone, only to see -<NL><NL>Countless crimson ashes pour unceasingly from the cracks in the blackstone.<NL>Seven black claws, as hideous as fangs, bind a young girl tightly to the blackstone.<NL>The girl's body is almost completely devoured by the blackstone; only half of her blood‑stained face remains barely exposed.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> sees clearly - tears already burst forth -<NL>this young girl... is Huanxin...
580a61f7-0250-42a2-9faa-4c3910b3ae9f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />遁声上前，<NL>很快，便赶到了那块巨大的玄石旁边，只见——<NL><NL>无数殷红的灰烬不住地自玄石的裂缝当中散落出来，<NL>七根狰狞如獠牙一般的黑爪将一个少女牢牢地缚在玄石之上，<NL>少女的身子几乎已完全被玄石吞噬，只有半边沾着血污的脸，仍勉强露在外面，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />看得清楚，泪水已然决堤，<NL>这少女……正是焕心……

6d333ccc-ea82-4def-a1c6-b70c59826139/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has defeated Yi Yihou!<NL><NL>Although <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> fought Yi Yihou to the death,<NL>after she loses, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> inexplicably feels pity for her...<NL>"That very gaze... just like my plain fox..."<NL>Yi Yihou smiles through tears. Before her words fade, she turns into peach blossom petals, drifting away in the wind...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Obtained <ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>...)</color>
6d333ccc-ea82-4def-a1c6-b70c59826139/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />击败了衣以侯！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />虽与衣以侯生死相拼，<NL>但待她败下阵来，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />却莫名地怜惜起她……<NL>“便是这个眼神……与我那丑狐一模一样……”<NL>衣以侯笑中带泪，话音未落，已化成了片片桃花，随风而去……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（获得<ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>……）</color>

17bee0bd-ff71-4746-9df6-f09c97edabf0/Eve.en: In the moments before death...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />seems to see...<NL>Huanxin using the last of her divine power to break free from the blackstone,<NL>charging at Xiangshu with her palm as a sword!<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> seems to hear...<NL>Huanxin whispering softly into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s ear,<NL>"Mysterious and unnamed, ethereal and formless, mystic god shines brilliantly, the heart is pure light!"<NL><NL>Then, everything before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s eyes turns pitch black, as if falling into an unfathomably deep, dry well...
17bee0bd-ff71-4746-9df6-f09c97edabf0/Eve.cn: 弥留之际……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />仿佛看到……<NL>焕心用尽最后的神力挣脱玄石，<NL>以掌作剑拼死冲向相枢！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />仿佛听到……<NL>焕心在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />耳边轻声嘱咐：<NL>“冥冥未名，恍恍无形，玄神焕灿，心即光明！”<NL><NL>随后，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />眼前一黑，仿佛落入了一口深不见底的枯井……

17bee0bd-ff71-4746-9df6-f09c97edabf0/Opt.en: Mystic god shines brilliantly, the heart is pure light... Huanxin... Huanxin...
17bee0bd-ff71-4746-9df6-f09c97edabf0/Opt.cn: 玄神焕灿，心即光明……焕心……焕心……
17bee0bd-ff71-4746-9df6-f09c97edabf0/Opt.ru: Мистический бог сияет ослепительно, сердце - это чистый свет... Хуаньсинь... Хуаньсинь...

f187f8da-3534-49dd-94ba-c6953c9a407c/Eve.en: Immediately, the azure waters begin to boil...<NL>A figure slowly rises from the water...
f187f8da-3534-49dd-94ba-c6953c9a407c/Eve.cn: 紧接着，碧水沸腾……<NL>一个人影随之缓缓地自水中升起……
f187f8da-3534-49dd-94ba-c6953c9a407c/Eve.ru: Лазурные воды сразу же начинают бурлить...<NL>Из воды медленно поднимается фигура...

6c661476-cbea-4c05-a491-b61d462f323c/Eve.en: "Ugrh... I can still fight! Let us fight once more!"<NL>The figure had a ferocious look and lunged as soon as he saw <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!
6c661476-cbea-4c05-a491-b61d462f323c/Eve.cn: “呜……吾还能再战！再战！”<NL>来人面带凶狂之气，一见到<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，便向其袭来！
6c661476-cbea-4c05-a491-b61d462f323c/Eve.ru: - Угу... Я все еще могу сражаться! Давайте сразимся еще раз!"<NL>У фигуры был свирепый вид, и она бросилась на него, как только увидела <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!

017dcb0c-8c2a-48b5-969b-95a3b5791034/Eve.en: "Now that the message has been found, quickly return your spirit to its origin!"<NL>Immortal Xu's command is like a lifeline lowered from above the dry well to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL>Already senseless, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> cannot think—they just grabs hold!<NL>Instantly, mists rise and clouds surge. Xiangshu's roars and Huanxin's whispers gradually fade away...
017dcb0c-8c2a-48b5-969b-95a3b5791034/Eve.cn: “消息既已探得，速速返神归元！”<NL>徐仙公一声敕令，好似从枯井之上向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />垂下了一根救命长绳，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />神智已失，不能多想，便即抓紧！<NL>顿时，雾起云腾，相枢的咆哮、焕心的叮咛渐渐远去……

d9895f60-9116-4ead-a25c-89a672053f2a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> ponders for a moment, growing more alarmed the more they think about it.<NL>This journey to the Land of Blackstones was already a matter of life and death.<NL>Now trapped in this eerie realm, the weather has been neither sunny nor rainy along the way. Thinking it over, they feel certain that a great disaster lies ahead.<NL>Not fully confident, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> decides to turn back the way they came and awaken from the Soul Egression...
d9895f60-9116-4ead-a25c-89a672053f2a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />沉思片刻，越想越觉心惊，<NL>此番前往玄石之境，本就是九死一生之事，<NL>如今入得诡境，一路上却是不晴不雨，思前想后，只觉得定有莫大的灾厄伏在前方，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中并无十足的把握，只好自原路折返，从出神之法中醒转……

d9895f60-9116-4ead-a25c-89a672053f2a/Opt.en: (Had no choice but to wait for the next opportunity...)
d9895f60-9116-4ead-a25c-89a672053f2a/Opt.ru: (У меня не было другого выбора, кроме как ждать следующей возможности...)

1dcee8aa-6b28-4602-815b-deb541b20b59/Eve.en: By borrowing the power of Black Bamboo to perform the Art of Soul Egression, Immortal Xu has already departed from the mortal realm.<NL>All that remains is a wooden shell sitting cross-legged, along with sixteen characters written on the ground before them,<NL>"Fuyu possesses a spirit, guarding essence and protecting the heart. Focus the mind and enter meditation, and guidance shall naturally arrive..."
1dcee8aa-6b28-4602-815b-deb541b20b59/Eve.cn: 徐仙公借助玄竹之力，行了出神之法，便已不在现世之中，<NL>只留下一副盘腿而坐的木头躯壳以及写在其身前地上的十六个大字：<NL>“伏虞有灵，守元护心，凝神入定，自有召引……”

2ea32339-1236-4716-b39e-1b8996caead9/Eve.en: "Mystic god shines brilliantly, the heart is pure light..."
2ea32339-1236-4716-b39e-1b8996caead9/Eve.ru: "Мистический бог сияет ослепительно, сердце - чистый свет..."

4be33df8-607a-4501-b7fd-1b4e962664ab/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> is struck in a vital spot by Xiangshu and falls into a pool of blood...
4be33df8-607a-4501-b7fd-1b4e962664ab/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />被相枢击中要害，倒在了一片血泊之中……
4be33df8-607a-4501-b7fd-1b4e962664ab/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> получает удар Сяншу в жизненно важное место и падает в лужу крови...

90389492-2cb0-4e77-8a54-00f3b56be612/Eve.en: "Outside a desolate village, a fleeting encounter.<NL>The maiden's mind wanders, the Delirious Mind bleeds fresh.<NL>Demons dance with claws, seeking to cover the vast sky.<NL>Taiwu bares their heart, heading toward the endless abyss.<NL>If we do not witness the birth of demons, how can we know of Taiwu's death? For three hundred years hence, we meet inverted in dreams..."<NL><NL>Huanxin sings softly, her expression both sorrowful and joyful, the tune both bitter and sweet, as if remembering the past...
90389492-2cb0-4e77-8a54-00f3b56be612/Eve.cn: “荒村之外，一面之缘，<NL>丫头神乱，痴儿血鲜，<NL>妖魔舞爪，要盖长天，<NL>太吾剖心，且向无间，<NL>不见妖魔生，岂知太吾死，此后三百年，梦里颠倒见……”<NL><NL>焕心轻轻唱道，表情亦愁亦喜，曲调亦苦亦甜，似是忆起了往事……

90389492-2cb0-4e77-8a54-00f3b56be612/Opt.en: If we do not witness the birth of demons, how can we know of Taiwu's death? For three hundred years hence, we meet inverted in dreams...
90389492-2cb0-4e77-8a54-00f3b56be612/Opt.cn: 不见妖魔生，岂知太吾死……此后三百年，梦里颠倒见……
90389492-2cb0-4e77-8a54-00f3b56be612/Opt.ru: Если мы не станем свидетелями рождения демонов, как мы можем узнать о смерти Тайу? В течение трехсот лет мы встречаемся перевернутыми в снах...

36ba9a6f-af49-4b63-8e54-9fccb2f61f95/Eve.en: Immediately, ice cracks and snow avalanches...<NL>A figure slowly walks out of the wind and snow...
36ba9a6f-af49-4b63-8e54-9fccb2f61f95/Eve.cn: 紧接着，冰裂雪崩……<NL>一个人影随之缓缓地自风雪中走来……
36ba9a6f-af49-4b63-8e54-9fccb2f61f95/Eve.ru: Сразу же лед трескается и сходят снежные лавины...<NL>Фигура медленно выходит из-под ветра и снега...

79e68120-c556-48ab-bba7-c682672ae3a9/Eve.en: After another moment,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> endures the pain and looks up again.<NL>The nameless bones nearby are multiplying...<NL>These bones take on various shapes; some are over ten feet long, winding and intertwining like giant serpents. Upon closer inspection, they are definitely not human bones...
79e68120-c556-48ab-bba7-c682672ae3a9/Eve.cn: 又过片刻，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />强忍疼痛，举目再看，<NL>身边无名的骸骨竟越来越多……<NL>这些骸骨形状各异，有的长达丈余，好似蟒蛇蜿蜒错结，细细观来，绝非人骨……

09ad362a-a6ac-4818-b662-0ef7f62101eb/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> is struck in a vital spot and falls into a pool of blood...
09ad362a-a6ac-4818-b662-0ef7f62101eb/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />被击中了要害，倒在了血泊之中……
09ad362a-a6ac-4818-b662-0ef7f62101eb/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> получает удар в жизненно важное место и падает в лужу крови...

a2565b2f-cba0-4c48-981f-5cc13371f6be/Eve.en: After another moment,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> endures the pain and looks up again.<NL>The objects emitting golden light have finally revealed their true form—<NL>It turns out they are countless patterns forged from pure gold, covering the ground all around <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!
a2565b2f-cba0-4c48-981f-5cc13371f6be/Eve.cn: 又过片刻，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />强忍疼痛，举目再看，<NL>那些发出金光的物事也终于露出了真容——<NL>原来，竟是无数赤金铸成的图纹铺满了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的四周！

41e5dc52-1930-4514-aa53-7dcaa5f9bca0/Eve.en: Then, all things dissolve.<NL>The jade mountains and jade tree sink into crimson ashes dotted with strange black stones.<NL>Corpses with grim, terrifying expressions appear all around, interwoven with the strange stones and ashes into a vision of hell,<NL>assaulting <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s eyes directly...
41e5dc52-1930-4514-aa53-7dcaa5f9bca0/Eve.cn: 随后，万物消解，<NL>玉山玉树沉入了一片长着玄色怪石的殷红灰烬之中，<NL>一具又一具死状狰狞的尸体也在周围显现出来，与怪石、灰烬交织成一幅炼狱景象，<NL>直闯入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的眼帘……

41e5dc52-1930-4514-aa53-7dcaa5f9bca0/Opt.en: Blackstone LandThis place... is already the Land of Blackstones?!
41e5dc52-1930-4514-aa53-7dcaa5f9bca0/Opt.ru: Земля Блэкстоуна - это место... неужели это уже Земля Блэкстоунов?!

f47521ac-0f76-41d8-a7d5-a3d095a35541/Eve.en: "O' living jade. O' living jade. The Xirang earth has revived a soul once lost.<NL>O' living jade. O' living jade. You became a child to meet mankind for the first time.<NL>O' living jade. O' living jade. So shy, and find joy in solitude...<NL>Oops, the jade is gone! Did you steal my living jade?"<NL>The figure sang, staring at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and seemingly thought that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> stole his "living jade"...
f47521ac-0f76-41d8-a7d5-a3d095a35541/Eve.cn: “玉活，玉活，溶去息壤凝作魂，<NL>玉活，玉活，如是孩童初见人，<NL>玉活，玉活，羞与人望常常隐……<NL>哎呀，玉不见啦！可是你偷走了我的活玉？”<NL>来人唱罢，两眼直勾勾地盯着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />看，似乎便是<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />偷走了他的“活玉”……

a26624ca-8082-41d4-b9d4-de8afc0e5259/Eve.en: Immediately, a strong wind sweeps up fallen leaves...<NL>A figure slowly walks forward, draped in maple leaves falling from the sky...
a26624ca-8082-41d4-b9d4-de8afc0e5259/Eve.cn: 紧接着，大风扫起落叶……<NL>一个人影随之缓缓地披着漫天飘落的枫叶走来……
a26624ca-8082-41d4-b9d4-de8afc0e5259/Eve.ru: Тут же сильный ветер подхватывает опавшие листья...<NL>Фигура медленно идет вперед, задрапированная кленовыми листьями, падающими с неба...

a64c0af2-eaba-493a-a658-b4383a471292/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has defeated Jin Huang'er!<NL><NL>Though Jin Huang'er is seriously injured, she still giggles, "Yes, it's you!"<NL>She ladles a bowl of golden wine and hands it to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> can't help but reach out to take it,<NL>but in the blink of an eye, there's nothing there...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Obtained <ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>...)</color>
a64c0af2-eaba-493a-a658-b4383a471292/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />击败了金凰儿！<NL><NL>金凰儿虽身受重伤，却仍嘻嘻而笑：“不错，便是你啦！”<NL>她说着，盛了一碗金黄的美酒递来给<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />不由自主地想要去接，<NL>哪知一眨眼，眼前便什么也没有了……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（获得<ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>……）</color>

8517f8f4-5bb7-4919-8a17-26b95b417c27/Eve.en: Huanxin nods painfully.<NL>"For over three hundred years... to reforge the 'Fuyu Sword', I don't know how many 'Taiwu' have come here seeking me.<NL>But the demons are cunning and evil... I think only one person has ever managed to escape this Land of Blackstones alive...<NL>After that person left, no 'Taiwu' ever came again,<NL>until I... met you..."
8517f8f4-5bb7-4919-8a17-26b95b417c27/Eve.cn: 焕心痛苦地点了点头，<NL>“三百多年来……为了重铸「伏虞剑」，已不知有多少‘太吾’来此寻我，<NL>可是，妖魔奸恶……能由此玄石之境侥幸生还者，想来却仅有一人……<NL>自那人走后，再也不见‘太吾’来此，<NL>直到我……遇到了你……”

8517f8f4-5bb7-4919-8a17-26b95b417c27/Opt.en: To reforge the 'Fuyu Sword'... seek you... who exactly are you...
8517f8f4-5bb7-4919-8a17-26b95b417c27/Opt.cn: 为了重铸「伏虞剑」……来寻你……你究竟是……
8517f8f4-5bb7-4919-8a17-26b95b417c27/Opt.ru: Чтобы перековать "Меч Фую"... ищу тебя... кто ты такой на самом деле?..

87c8cb48-c144-435e-961f-439267a3e162/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> becomes confused and inadvertently glances back,<NL>only to be shocked to see themselves still sitting quietly nearby, as if they had never set out at all...
87c8cb48-c144-435e-961f-439267a3e162/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />疑惑起来，无意间回头一望，<NL>岂料竟看到自己仍静坐在不远处，好似自己不曾出发过一样……
87c8cb48-c144-435e-961f-439267a3e162/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> приходит в замешательство и невольно оглядывается назад,<NL>только для того, чтобы быть потрясенными, увидев, что они все еще тихо сидят неподалеку, как будто они вообще никуда не выходили...

dc3042f0-6269-46e6-989b-978a50d534b0/Eve.en: Then, all things dissolve.<NL>The bone piles sink into crimson ashes dotted with strange black stones.<NL>Corpses with grim, terrifying expressions appear all around, interwoven with the strange stones and ashes into a vision of hell,<NL>assaulting <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s eyes directly...
dc3042f0-6269-46e6-989b-978a50d534b0/Eve.cn: 随后，万物消解，<NL>骨堆沉入了一片长着玄色怪石的殷红灰烬之中，<NL>一具又一具死状狰狞的尸体也在周围显现出来，与怪石、灰烬交织成一幅炼狱景象，<NL>直闯入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的眼帘……

dc3042f0-6269-46e6-989b-978a50d534b0/Opt.en: Blackstone LandThis place... is already the Land of Blackstones?!
dc3042f0-6269-46e6-989b-978a50d534b0/Opt.ru: Земля Блэкстоуна - это место... неужели это уже Земля Блэкстоунов?!

8d0a8dd2-e2f8-45c7-90c0-e0088a8480c2/Eve.en: The white light quietly fades, leaving countless thoughts...<NL>So... Huanxin is the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color>...
8d0a8dd2-e2f8-45c7-90c0-e0088a8480c2/Eve.cn: 白光悄然散尽，思绪已有万千……<NL>原来……焕心即是<color=#yellow>「伏虞剑」</color>……
8d0a8dd2-e2f8-45c7-90c0-e0088a8480c2/Eve.ru: Белый свет тихо угасает, оставляя после себя бесчисленные мысли...<NL>Итак... Хуаньсинь - это тот <color=#yellow>Меч Фую</color>...

3e54ad5e-6b3d-49e5-8384-e1208e79a9fc/Eve.en: A thousand years pass in the blink of an eye...<NL>Relics lie buried in desolate soil; the divine sword endures endless torment.<NL>Who knows what Heaven intends? Suddenly awakening spiritual intelligence without precedent...<NL>From then on... heaven and earth become lovely, all things become visible; vast seas turn into mulberry fields, the mortal world gains a new face!<NL>Amid laughter and tears, an innocent child descends to the world!
3e54ad5e-6b3d-49e5-8384-e1208e79a9fc/Eve.cn: 转眼千年过去……<NL>宝物埋于荒土，神剑受尽熬煎，<NL>不知天意作何想？忽启灵智无此先……<NL>自此……天地皆可爱，万物得以见，沧海变桑田，尘世有新颜！<NL>哭笑一阵中，赤子降人间！

f78619ab-6bf0-434d-8c78-451b700750ac/Eve.en: After another moment,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> endures the pain and looks up again.<NL>TThe surrounding snow has already buried <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s body!<NL>A layer of frost has formed on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />; each breath feels like exhaling and inhaling sharp ice blades...
f78619ab-6bf0-434d-8c78-451b700750ac/Eve.cn: 又过片刻，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />强忍疼痛，举目再看，<NL>四周的积雪已没过了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的身体！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的身上结起了一层寒霜，每一次呼吸都仿佛在吐吞锐利的冰刀……

bc5a16fb-383e-4896-b97a-d881de25767e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has defeated the Blood Maple!<NL><NL>Though severely wounded, the Blood Maple still brandishes his claws and stands tall. He looks about to pounce on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> again!<NL>But just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> prepares to meet the enemy a second time, the Blood Maple's body suddenly freezes.<NL>It turns out he died some time ago; he quickly breaks into several segments of maple wood, scattering on the ground...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Obtained <ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>...)</color>
bc5a16fb-383e-4896-b97a-d881de25767e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />击败了血枫！<NL><NL>血枫虽然身受重伤，仍张牙舞爪，矗立不倒，眼看又要向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />扑来！<NL>但是，当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />准备好二度迎敌时，血枫的身形却忽然凝固，<NL>原来早已气绝多时，很快化作数段枫木散落了一地……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（获得<ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>……）</color>

a784c45e-681b-4c8d-8714-9d8bd9f311e1/Eve.en: Then, all things dissolve.<NL>The maple forest sinks into crimson ashes dotted with strange black stones.<NL>Corpses with grim, terrifying expressions appear all around, interwoven with the strange stones and ashes into a vision of hell,<NL>assaulting <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s eyes directly...
a784c45e-681b-4c8d-8714-9d8bd9f311e1/Eve.cn: 随后，万物消解，<NL>枫林沉入了一片长着玄色怪石的殷红灰烬之中，<NL>一具又一具死状狰狞的尸体也在周围显现出来，与怪石、灰烬交织成一幅炼狱景象，<NL>直闯入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的眼帘……

a784c45e-681b-4c8d-8714-9d8bd9f311e1/Opt.ru: Земля Блэкстоуна - это место... неужели это уже Земля Блэкстоунов?!

b5de8ea7-81c3-455d-9a27-6db9d63f6d16/Eve.en: Immediately, the patterns turn into golden threads weaving a giant cocoon...<NL>A figure slowly leaps out from the cocoon...
b5de8ea7-81c3-455d-9a27-6db9d63f6d16/Eve.cn: 紧接着，图纹变成金丝织成巨茧……<NL>一个人影随之缓缓地自茧中跃出……
b5de8ea7-81c3-455d-9a27-6db9d63f6d16/Eve.ru: Узоры мгновенно превращаются в золотые нити, Ткачество которых превращается в гигантский кокон...<NL>Из кокона медленно выпрыгивает фигура...

bf4cac3c-3daa-401e-b55c-92d80830b5a3/Eve.en: After a long time...<NL>a piercing pain awakens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> struggles to open their eyes, only to find themselves lying on a pale, alien substance,<NL>as if the bones of some giant creature surround <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...
bf4cac3c-3daa-401e-b55c-92d80830b5a3/Eve.cn: 许久之后……<NL>一阵刺骨的疼痛将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />唤醒，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />挣扎着睁开双眼，发现自己正躺在一片苍白的异物之上，<NL>好像某种巨物的骨骸围绕在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的身边……

8b94152f-d40d-4c10-a003-608533241c0d/Eve.en: Then, the wind blows, clouds move, warblers fly, and grass grows—the scenery here actually changes.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> also suddenly feels clear-minded and sharp-eyed, no longer as confused and drowsy as before...
8b94152f-d40d-4c10-a003-608533241c0d/Eve.cn: 随后，风吹云动，莺飞草长，此间风光竟有所变，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />亦顿时感到心清目明，不复先前迷惑困倦之感……
8b94152f-d40d-4c10-a003-608533241c0d/Eve.ru: Затем дует ветер, движутся облака, летают соловьи и растет трава — пейзаж здесь действительно меняется.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> также внезапно ощущает ясность ума и зоркость глаз, уже не такую растерянную и сонливую, как раньше...

8b94152f-d40d-4c10-a003-608533241c0d/Opt.en: Could it be... that person was the embodiment of the obstacles in my heart...
8b94152f-d40d-4c10-a003-608533241c0d/Opt.cn: 莫非……那人便是我心中迷障所化……
8b94152f-d40d-4c10-a003-608533241c0d/Opt.ru: Могло ли это быть... этот человек был воплощением препятствий в моем сердце?..

0e18cfa8-4271-4b49-a0c3-5a4b78bed489/Eve.en: Immediately, peach blossoms flutter...<NL>A figure slowly walks out from the peach grove...
0e18cfa8-4271-4b49-a0c3-5a4b78bed489/Eve.cn: 紧接着，桃花纷飞……<NL>一个人影随之缓缓地自桃林中走出……
0e18cfa8-4271-4b49-a0c3-5a4b78bed489/Eve.ru: Тут же распускаются цветы персика...<NL>Из персиковой рощи медленно выходит фигура...

e1895de9-7e19-40ae-ae93-5b0ecb1d91be/Eve.en: "Spare me, and the world shall perish. Slay me, and the world shall perish all the same!<NL>Ha! Ha! Ha! Such childish rhymes are the height of folly!<NL>Even were you granted ten thousand ages more, how could you ever hope to stand against me?"<NL>Xiangshu throws his head back and laughs maniacally, yet at his throat, a faint white light flashes...
e1895de9-7e19-40ae-ae93-5b0ecb1d91be/Eve.cn: “不灭本座，便无人间！灭得本座，更无人间！<NL>哈！哈！哈！此等小儿歌谣，愚不可及！<NL>尔等纵然再用万万年，又焉可与本座匹敌！”<NL>相枢仰头狂笑道，咽喉之处，却隐隐闪出一道白光……

8c3b3d21-537d-4e8f-b74d-cde187936f36/Eve.en: After a long time...<NL>a piercing pain awakens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> struggles to open their eyes, only to find themselves in a fiery red maple forest,<NL>occasionally hearing the sounds of battle from within the woods...
8c3b3d21-537d-4e8f-b74d-cde187936f36/Eve.cn: 许久之后……<NL>一阵刺骨的疼痛将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />唤醒，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />挣扎着睁开双眼，发现自己正身处一片火红的枫林之中，<NL>偶尔还能听到林中传出杀伐之声……
8c3b3d21-537d-4e8f-b74d-cde187936f36/Eve.ru: Спустя долгое время...<NL>пробуждается пронзительная боль <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> изо всех сил пытаются открыть глаза только для того, чтобы обнаружить себя в огненно-красном кленовом лесу,<NL>время от времени из леса доносились звуки битвы...

b59f6f54-b2f3-4bf6-94f9-0226cb57807f/Eve.en: "Ha! Ha! Ha! You rat-like 'Taiwu'!<NL>If you hadn't picked up a fraction of the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color>'s power, you wouldn't even have the chance to embarrass yourselves before me!<NL>Today, I will make a meal of you and devour Huanxin as well! That would be a fitting end to our acquaintance!"<NL><NL>Xiangshu laughs loudly, spreads his arms wreathed in black flames, and encircles everything around him.<NL>Then, like an endless black cloud,<NL>he sweeps down upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!
b59f6f54-b2f3-4bf6-94f9-0226cb57807f/Eve.cn: “哈！哈！哈！「太吾」鼠辈！<NL>若非尔等拾得<color=#yellow>「伏虞剑」</color>半成威力，岂有在本座殿前现眼的机会！<NL>本座今日便要拿你佐餐，将焕心一并吞吃！也不枉尔等与本座相识一场呐！”<NL><NL>相枢放声大笑，张开裹着黑焰的手臂，将四周一把围住，<NL>随后，如同一片无边无际的黑云般，<NL>向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />席卷而来！

b59f6f54-b2f3-4bf6-94f9-0226cb57807f/Opt.ru: (Отступление невозможно! Встреться лицом к лицу с демоном!)

2536880c-2946-44c0-9785-6360d88b30b7/Eve.en: After another moment,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> endures the pain and looks up again.<NL>Unexpectedly, this maple forest looks like an ancient battlefield!<NL>Countless spears, daggers, axes, and swords are discarded on the ground; tattered banners and war drums are scattered around the forest...
2536880c-2946-44c0-9785-6360d88b30b7/Eve.cn: 又过片刻，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />强忍疼痛，举目再看，<NL>不料这枫林竟好似一座远古战场！<NL>大量的矛戈刀斧被扔弃在地，破败的旌旗、战鼓散落在枫林的四周……

8f326e7f-a913-4eee-9882-2e463ece035f/Eve.en: "I brought back the sword with my life. Why did you not come and take it?<NL>You must still be blaming me for my recklessness, but no matter. I shall use this sword to kill you then..."<NL>Monu whispered quietly, but before she finished, she lunged straight at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!
8f326e7f-a913-4eee-9882-2e463ece035f/Eve.cn: “那剑我已舍身取回，你为何还不来拿？<NL>你定是仍在怪我鲁莽，也罢，我便用那剑将你杀了吧……”<NL>莫女幽幽地念道，话音未落，突然直扑向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />！
8f326e7f-a913-4eee-9882-2e463ece035f/Eve.ru: "Я вернул Меч ценой своей жизни. Почему ты не пришел и не забрал его?<NL>Ты, должно быть, все еще винишь меня за мое безрассудство, но это неважно. Тогда я воспользуюсь этим Мечом, чтобы убить тебя..."<NL>- тихо прошептала Мону, но прежде чем она закончила, она бросилась прямо на <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!

39363c2f-383b-4483-ab5a-5986e74b74b2/Eve.en: "The flood is coming, yet you won't take shelter...<NL>I want to save your lives, but you fear me more than the flood—you won't even look at me... sigh..."<NL>The newcomer says sorrowfully, then suddenly turns and, as if turning into a piercing cold wind, attacks <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> head-on!
39363c2f-383b-4483-ab5a-5986e74b74b2/Eve.cn: “洪水将至，你们却不去避祸……<NL>我欲救你们性命，你们反倒怕我多过于怕洪水，连我的面也不想看到……唉……”<NL>来人悲伤地说着，忽然一个转身，犹如化作一阵刺骨的寒风，迎面向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />袭来！

f6d1c43e-bff6-4fce-b1ce-8d02bcea8d6b/Eve.en: After walking east for an unknown distance,<NL>the scenery around remains unchanged, and heaven and earth are utterly silent.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> grows weary and can't help but feel puzzled...
f6d1c43e-bff6-4fce-b1ce-8d02bcea8d6b/Eve.cn: 又不知往东走了多远，<NL>四周风光不改，天地一片死寂，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />渐感困乏，不由得心生疑惑……
f6d1c43e-bff6-4fce-b1ce-8d02bcea8d6b/Eve.ru: Пройдя на восток неизвестное расстояние,<NL>пейзаж вокруг остается неизменным, а небо и земля совершенно безмолвны.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> устает и не может не чувствовать себя озадаченным...

f6d1c43e-bff6-4fce-b1ce-8d02bcea8d6b/Opt.en: There is no distinction between front, back, left, or right here - could I have taken the wrong direction?!
f6d1c43e-bff6-4fce-b1ce-8d02bcea8d6b/Opt.cn: 此地前后左右，没有半点分别，莫非……是我走错了方向？！
f6d1c43e-bff6-4fce-b1ce-8d02bcea8d6b/Opt.ru: Здесь нет различия между передом, задом, левым или правым - мог ли я выбрать неправильное направление?!

f437764a-d0a3-4310-aa60-99e1b49ba8b0/Eve.en: "There is no distinction between front, back, left, or right here - could I have taken the wrong direction?!"<NL>The man says exactly the same words as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, quickly arriving beside <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL>The two look at each other, as if seeing their own reflection in a mirror - not a single difference...
f437764a-d0a3-4310-aa60-99e1b49ba8b0/Eve.cn: “此地前后左右，没有半点分别，莫非……是我走错了方向？！”<NL>那人说着与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />一模一样的话，很快便来到了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的身边，<NL>二人你瞧着我，我瞧着你，如同对镜照影，竟无分毫不同……

f437764a-d0a3-4310-aa60-99e1b49ba8b0/Opt.en: Who are you?! Why have you taken my form?!
f437764a-d0a3-4310-aa60-99e1b49ba8b0/Opt.cn: 你是何人？！为何化作我的模样？！
f437764a-d0a3-4310-aa60-99e1b49ba8b0/Opt.ru: Кто ты такой?! Почему ты принял мой облик?!

9fae8b20-2f61-4823-b71a-729d4f968fe2/Eve.en: "Heaven above, earth below, beneath this righteous sky... why do such abominations endlessly plague the world?<NL>And what kind of demon are you?! No matter. Be you Buddha or demon... all must be cut down. All must be cut down..."<NL>After speaking, the newcomer suddenly lets out a great shout and charges straight at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!
9fae8b20-2f61-4823-b71a-729d4f968fe2/Eve.cn: “苍天厚土，朗朗乾坤，何以会有这许多杀不尽、除不完的邪物？<NL>你又是何方妖怪？！是了，任你是佛是魔……尽皆当斩，当斩……”<NL>来人说完，突然一声大喝，径直向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />袭来！

1553bf2e-93d4-4cba-9ca5-a1131b17e606/Eve.en: After another moment,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> endures the pain and looks up again.<NL>The scene before them has become even more hallucinatory!<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks around but sees only twilight glow everywhere - day, night, and direction are all indistinguishable...
1553bf2e-93d4-4cba-9ca5-a1131b17e606/Eve.cn: 又过片刻，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />强忍疼痛，举目再看，<NL>眼前的景象已变得愈加迷幻！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />举目四顾，却只见处处是霞光，昼夜与方向皆不可分辨……

3d94bb65-c918-49ec-be60-b8dd04584214/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has defeated Jiu Han!<NL><NL>Countless ice and snow scatter from Jiu Han's body; in an instant, heaven and earth seem to turn into an ice palace!<NL>Through the swirling blizzard, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> seems to see the countless snowflakes transform into a gentle snow maiden,<NL>who softly takes Jiu Han's hand and leads him away into the wind and snow...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Obtained <ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>...)</color>
3d94bb65-c918-49ec-be60-b8dd04584214/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />击败了九寒！<NL><NL>无数冰雪自九寒的身躯之中飞散出来，一时之间，天地如入冰宫！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />透过冰雪，仿佛看到漫天的雪花化作了一位温柔的雪女，<NL>轻轻拉起九寒的手，带着他消失在了风雪之中……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（获得<ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>……）</color>

6987a481-925e-4c26-a831-55fcbde12883/Eve.en: Then, all things dissolve.<NL>The pile of rubble sinks into crimson ashes dotted with strange black stones.<NL>Corpses with grim, terrifying expressions appear all around, interwoven with the strange stones and ashes into a vision of hell,<NL>assaulting <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s eyes directly...

With a single thought, the divine sword is first unsealed...<NL>You are 'Taiwu'... you must possess the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Hilt</color>... take it out and look...<NL>then... you will understand..."
78a36590-f382-4c72-9bbe-59a254e89aa8/Eve.cn: “千载真力谁承负？一念神剑初开封……<NL>你是「太吾」……必有<color=#yellow>「伏虞剑柄」</color>……取出一观……<NL>自有……分晓……”
78a36590-f382-4c72-9bbe-59a254e89aa8/Eve.ru: - Кто несет на себе груз тысячелетней Подлинной Власти? С помощью одной-единственной мысли божественный Меч сначала распечатывается...<NL>Ты - "Тайу"... вы должны обладать <color=#yellow>Рукоять Фую</color>.. достаньте его и посмотрите...<NL>тогда... ты поймешь..."

0554b6c7-41f2-40e3-8a9d-b58233357254/Eve.en: But...<NL>Misfortune may befall a person at any moment; the weather too is unpredictable.<NL>The innocent one made a vow in times of peril, wielding boundless power, yet it only freed the demon, tearing heaven and earth apart.<NL><NL>And so... to mend the heavens!<NL>Man and demon dueled with swords in the mountains—body destroyed, heart dead—how sorrowful!<NL>Their souls became divine weapons, fighting again—shaking heaven and earth, breaking in two!<NL>One half fell beneath the blackstones; the other landed on Delirious Mind's shoulder...
0554b6c7-41f2-40e3-8a9d-b58233357254/Eve.cn: 只是……<NL>人有旦夕祸福难免，天有风云不测之变，<NL>赤子临难发愿，伟力无边，却令妖魔脱困，天崩地裂，<NL><NL>于是乎……为补苍天！<NL>人与妖魔山中比剑，身灭心死好不凄怨！<NL>魂作神兵复又鏖战，动地惊天断折两截！<NL>一截堕入玄石下，一截落在痴儿肩……

Tell me why?"<NL>The newcomer babbles nonsense while advancing toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> step by step, eyes flashing with murderous intent...
3f9b7afa-c005-4e02-a6ac-1d081e1a03e3/Eve.cn: “师父一直教导我：‘欲成大道，舍身取义’！<NL>我连命都舍了，可大道何在？！<NL>舍命难道及不上‘舍身’吗？！<NL>这是何故？你道这是何故？”<NL>来人一边胡言乱语，一边目露凶光地向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />步步逼近……

685a1cb7-6f1b-486b-aaa0-ae7c06140815/Eve.en: Immediately, fine jade shifts its form...<NL>A figure slowly emerges from the jade mountains and jade trees...
685a1cb7-6f1b-486b-aaa0-ae7c06140815/Eve.cn: 紧接着，美玉幻形……<NL>一个人影随之缓缓地自玉山玉树中变化出来……
685a1cb7-6f1b-486b-aaa0-ae7c06140815/Eve.ru: Прекрасный Нефрит мгновенно меняет свою форму...<NL>Из-за гор Нефрита и Нефрита-деревьев медленно появляется фигура...

e1f5637c-e06c-458a-9a85-1bb86fff6bd4/Eve.en: "Because that sword has already been served as a meal for me!"<NL>A terrifying voice suddenly echoes from all directions! It shakes the ground so violently that the blackstones shatter and the dead ashes rise into the air!
e1f5637c-e06c-458a-9a85-1bb86fff6bd4/Eve.cn: “因为，那剑已作了本座的盘中之餐！”<NL>可怖的声音突然从四面八方传来！直震得满地玄石破碎，死灰腾空扬起！
e1f5637c-e06c-458a-9a85-1bb86fff6bd4/Eve.ru: "Потому что этот Меч уже был подан мне на ужин!"<NL>Внезапно со всех сторон раздается ужасающий голос! Он сотрясает землю с такой силой, что черные камни разлетаются вдребезги, а мертвый пепел поднимается в воздух!

04da281d-b54f-4a6e-a284-be1bc7152591/Eve.en: "I am... the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color>, but I am also... Huanxin...<NL>Do not... hesitate any longer. The blade of the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color>... is impossible to recover...<NL>You... flee quickly..."
04da281d-b54f-4a6e-a284-be1bc7152591/Eve.cn: “我是……<color=#yellow>「伏虞剑」</color>，我也是……焕心……<NL>你……莫再迟疑，<color=#yellow>「伏虞剑」</color>的剑刃……已绝难找回……<NL>你……快些逃命……”
04da281d-b54f-4a6e-a284-be1bc7152591/Eve.ru: "Я... тот самый <color=#yellow>Меч Фую</color>, но и я тоже... Хуаньсинь...<NL>Не... колеблясь больше. Клинок из <color=#yellow>Меч Фую</color>... восстановить невозможно...<NL>Ты... быстро убегай..."

04da281d-b54f-4a6e-a284-be1bc7152591/Opt.en: Why is it impossible to recover?!

f0230223-aebb-49c7-af5d-86fb9ce38c6d/Eve.en: "Do not... cry...<NL>I have been like this for over three hundred years...<NL>The person you met by the cliff earlier—<NL>that was an illusion I conjured in the state of no-self. When I take 'her' form, the pain lessens a little...<NL>But... the demons are cunning. To wear down my spirit, they give me no moment's respite...<NL><NL>It was not easy for you to come here. You must... you must escape with your life.<NL>Do not end up like these 'Taiwu'... 'sleeping forever'... here..."<NL>Huanxin speaks with difficulty, tears streaming down her face as she looks at the piles of corpses around her...
f0230223-aebb-49c7-af5d-86fb9ce38c6d/Eve.cn: “你莫要……哭泣……<NL>我这般模样，已有三百多年……<NL>方才那个与你在崖边相见之人，<NL>乃是我化在无我之境中的一个幻影，我幻作‘她’时，身上便不如何疼痛了……<NL>只是……妖魔狡诈，为了折损我的心神，容不得我片刻喘息……<NL><NL>你来此不易，一定要……一定要逃出生天，<NL>莫要像这些「太吾」一样……‘长眠’……于此……”<NL>焕心吃力地说着，眼睛望向四周成堆的尸体，潸然泪下……

f0230223-aebb-49c7-af5d-86fb9ce38c6d/Opt.en: All these dead... are they... all 'Taiwu'...?
f0230223-aebb-49c7-af5d-86fb9ce38c6d/Opt.cn: 这些死去的人……都是……“太吾”么……
f0230223-aebb-49c7-af5d-86fb9ce38c6d/Opt.ru: Все эти мертвецы... это они... все "Тайу"...?

00c8e1e4-06f0-40bc-b689-bc571b120196/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> is struck in a vital spot and falls into a pool of blood...
00c8e1e4-06f0-40bc-b689-bc571b120196/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />被击中了要害，倒在了血泊之中……
00c8e1e4-06f0-40bc-b689-bc571b120196/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> получает удар в жизненно важное место и падает в лужу крови...

a8fbc9d0-ddf8-46c9-a83b-d8cae1c3cba6/Eve.en: Immediately, a strange wind attacks...<NL>A figure slowly emerges from the pile of bones...
a8fbc9d0-ddf8-46c9-a83b-d8cae1c3cba6/Eve.cn: 紧接着，怪风袭来……<NL>一个人影随之缓缓地自骨堆中钻出……
a8fbc9d0-ddf8-46c9-a83b-d8cae1c3cba6/Eve.ru: Сразу же налетает странный ветер...<NL>Из груды костей медленно появляется фигура...

ce487543-8e36-4274-bba1-95b2fef0a33e/Eve.en: "Why is that?!"<NL>Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finishes speaking, an identical voice suddenly comes from nearby.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> is startled, and then they sees the "themselves" sitting quietly not far away suddenly rise and walk over...
ce487543-8e36-4274-bba1-95b2fef0a33e/Eve.cn: “这是何故？！”<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />话音未落，一个一模一样的声音忽然从不远处传来，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />吃了一惊，紧接着便看到静坐在不远处的“自己”倏地起身，向这边走来……
ce487543-8e36-4274-bba1-95b2fef0a33e/Eve.ru: "Почему это?!"<NL>До того, как <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> заканчивает говорить, и внезапно поблизости раздается идентичный голос.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> они поражены, а затем видят, как "они сами", тихо сидевшие неподалеку, внезапно встают и подходят к ним...

25f3c7e3-9280-43e8-aac3-a5575f607108/Eve.en: "Sigh, the same again...<NL>All you 'Taiwu' who manage to reach me—truly, not one of you can remember your own name...<NL>Taiwu... Taiwu... the greater self leads to no-self; it began with 'him' and has never changed..."<NL>Huanxin shakes her head, her eyes filled with both pity and even a hint of admiration...
25f3c7e3-9280-43e8-aac3-a5575f607108/Eve.cn: “唉，又是这样……<NL>你们这些「太吾」呀，能到得我这里的，果然便无一人能想起自己的姓名……<NL>太吾……太吾……大我乃至无我，自他而始，何曾更改……”<NL>焕心摇头道，眼中又是怜惜，竟又有些敬羡……

25f3c7e3-9280-43e8-aac3-a5575f607108/Opt.en: Began with 'him'? You not only know I am 'Taiwu', but you also know the origin of 'Taiwu'?
25f3c7e3-9280-43e8-aac3-a5575f607108/Opt.cn: 自他而始？你不仅知道我是“太吾”，亦知“太吾”之渊源？
25f3c7e3-9280-43e8-aac3-a5575f607108/Opt.ru: Начиналось с "него"? Вы не только знаете, что я "Тайу", но и знаете происхождение "Тайу"?

01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Eve.en: "Who are you?! Why have you taken my form?!"<NL>The person repeats exactly the same words, even their expression and movements identical to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s...
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Eve.cn: “你是何人？！为何化作我的模样？！”<NL>那人依样说来，连表情动作也与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />一模一样……
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Eve.ru: - Кто ты такой?! Почему ты принял мой облик?!"<NL>Человек повторяет в точности те же слова, даже выражение его лица и движения идентичны <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />с...

01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.en: The demonic realm of Blackstones surely harbors no good beings. Why not reveal your true form!
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.cn: 玄石妖境，定无善类，何不以真身相见！
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.ru: Демоническое царство Блэкстоунов, несомненно, не таит в себе добрых существ. Почему бы не раскрыть свой истинный облик?

01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.en: Such persistence—could it be that you are hindered by me?
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.cn: 如此纠缠，莫不是你受了我的阻碍？
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.ru: Такая настойчивость — может быть, я вам мешаю?

01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.en: All things between heaven and earth are nothing but Yin and Yang. The single breath of Yin and Yang... our hearts are aligned...
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.cn: 天地万物，不外阴阳，阴阳一气，你我同心……
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.ru: Все, что находится между небом и землей, есть не что иное, как Инь и Ян. Единое дыхание Инь и Ян... наши сердца совпадают...

01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.en: I am nothing but a featherless bird mimicking humans, parroting words and clumsily imitating a tiger!
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.cn: 我乃十足秃毛鸟人，向人学舌，照虎画猫！
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.ru: Я всего лишь птица без перьев, подражающая людям, повторяющая слова как попугай и неуклюже имитирующая тигра!

01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.en: If I cut off my own limbs, would you dare do the same!
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.cn: 我若自断手足，你亦敢照做么！
01942a57-4a12-4d38-84d2-eadc3ecbc10c/Opt.ru: Если я отрежу себе конечности, посмеешь ли ты сделать то же самое?

d7fc930b-d50c-48a4-917c-ca39c8e8c0cd/Eve.en: After a long time...<NL>a piercing pain awakens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> struggles to open their eyes, only to find themselves in a forest filled with blooming peach blossoms.<NL>Eerie blue phantom flames occasionally leap among the peach blossoms...
d7fc930b-d50c-48a4-917c-ca39c8e8c0cd/Eve.cn: 许久之后……<NL>一阵刺骨的疼痛将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />唤醒，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />挣扎着睁开双眼，发现自己正置身于一片开满桃花的桃林之中，<NL>一些幽蓝色的异火不时在桃花之中跳跃……

c1d4937f-ea1a-4402-9e51-c715a3cd7e7e/Eve.en: "In the Soul Egression illusion, all things are hazy.<NL>Life, death, fortune, and misfortune reside within a single heart.<NL>Continue east without hesitation..."<NL>Who knows how long it has been when Immortal Xu's voice suddenly sounds in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s ear...
c1d4937f-ea1a-4402-9e51-c715a3cd7e7e/Eve.cn: “出神幻境，万物迷离，<NL>死生福祸，存于一心，<NL>一路往东，不可迟疑……”<NL>也不知过去了多久，徐仙公的声音忽然在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />耳边响起……
c1d4937f-ea1a-4402-9e51-c715a3cd7e7e/Eve.ru: "В иллюзии выхода души все вещи туманны.<NL>Жизнь, смерть, удача и несчастье заключены в одном сердце.<NL>Продолжайте движение на восток без колебаний..."<NL>Кто знает, сколько времени прошло, когда голос Бессмертного Сюя внезапно звучит в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />его ухо...

1bac311a-a5bd-4b2a-9991-892f903bae24/Eve.en: Then, all things dissolve.<NL>The ice and snow sink into crimson ashes dotted with strange black stones.<NL>Corpses with grim, terrifying expressions appear all around, interwoven with the strange stones and ashes into a vision of hell,<NL>assaulting <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s eyes directly...
1bac311a-a5bd-4b2a-9991-892f903bae24/Eve.cn: 随后，万物消解，<NL>冰雪沉入了一片长着玄色怪石的殷红灰烬之中，<NL>一具又一具死状狰狞的尸体也在周围显现出来，与怪石、灰烬交织成一幅炼狱景象，<NL>直闯入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的眼帘……

1bac311a-a5bd-4b2a-9991-892f903bae24/Opt.en: Blackstone LandThis place... is already the Land of Blackstones?!
1bac311a-a5bd-4b2a-9991-892f903bae24/Opt.ru: Земля Блэкстоуна - это место... неужели это уже Земля Блэкстоунов?!

b2788235-e252-49d9-ab78-d7faf79b4af4/Eve.en: "This place is not the mortal world—how could there be any danger of falling from a cliff?"<NL>The girl laughs, her voice like silver bells.<NL>As soon as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> says it, they realize this and immediately regret it.<NL>Besides, how could there be mortals here? Who knows what demon this girl is? Why worry about her...
b2788235-e252-49d9-ab78-d7faf79b4af4/Eve.cn: “此处又非现世，岂有坠崖之危？”<NL>女孩儿笑道，声如银铃，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />话一出口，想到此节，便即后悔，<NL>更何况此间岂有凡人？也不知这女孩儿又是什么妖魔，何须为其担忧……

4cd2d68b-aae6-4d7e-aa3e-86e8bbd57b97/Eve.en: "Do you know where Plain Fox has gone?<NL>Did he ascend to the heaven palace? Or did he fall into the abyss?<NL>No, don't answer me. You are all trying to lie to me. Only my Plain Fox would never..."<NL>The more the figure spoke, the more sorrowful she became. Suddenly, her clothes flared up with unseen eerie flame, as she lunged at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!
4cd2d68b-aae6-4d7e-aa3e-86e8bbd57b97/Eve.cn: “你可知丑狐去了哪里？<NL>是飞上了天宫？是坠入了黄泉？<NL>你不必答我，你们都想欺骗于我，唯有我那丑狐……”<NL>来人越说越悲怆，突然衣衫燃起无明异火，飞身向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />袭来！

ef0dcba9-0b21-4985-84f2-65785609a3a2/Eve.en: "Piercing heaven and earth, transforming into myriad spirits. Every word holds heavenly secrets, every character is gold.<NL>I gift you several mysterious words; why bother listening if you do not cherish your life?<NL>If you follow my words and obey my command, I shall tear open my belly to offer my true heart.<NL>What are mere heavenly rules to fear? In this vast mortal world, do not live in vain!"<NL>Having finished singing, the person bursts into hearty laughter and suddenly launches into the air, striking swiftly at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!
ef0dcba9-0b21-4985-84f2-65785609a3a2/Eve.cn: “通天彻地化万灵，句句天机字字金，<NL>赠尔玄玄两三言，爱惜性命何必听？<NL>尔若依言奉我令，我亦破肚献真心，<NL>区区天规何足忌，茫茫人世莫虚行！”<NL>来人唱完，哈哈大笑，突然飞身向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />急袭而来！

2c6fd29b-1d24-4a5d-b72a-5cfe2b6d67c9/Eve.en: After another moment,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> endures the pain and looks up again.<NL>The aura of malice in the surroundings has grown even thicker!<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s breathing becomes heavy; it seems that lingering here a moment longer will make it impossible to ever leave alive...
2c6fd29b-1d24-4a5d-b72a-5cfe2b6d67c9/Eve.cn: 又过片刻，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />强忍疼痛，举目再看，<NL>周围的煞气变得愈发浓郁！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的呼吸渐渐变得沉重，似乎再在此处耽搁片刻，便再难生离此地……

2a4b1290-8177-406e-a110-7f0850bc028a/Eve.en: Unable to defeat <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, the person takes advantage of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s distraction to flee in panic.<NL>Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> wants to step forward to investigate what kind of monster they are, the person scatters into a pile of dust...
2a4b1290-8177-406e-a110-7f0850bc028a/Eve.cn: 那人不敌<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，竟趁<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />不备仓皇逃离，<NL>正当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />想要上前查明其究竟是何方妖怪时，那身影却已散作了一堆砂尘……

a9ed9c44-56c4-42d4-8f5a-5a0591c848e5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has defeated Spellwright!<NL><NL>Spellwright flips up, nods,<NL>then points to the sky with her token, then to the ground, before finally bowing deeply to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has no idea what Spellwright means by all this, but she rises on clouds and drifts away...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Obtained <ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>...)</color>
a9ed9c44-56c4-42d4-8f5a-5a0591c848e5/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />击败了术方！<NL><NL>术方翻身跃起，点了点头，<NL>又以手中的令牌指了指天，再指了指地，最后向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />一揖到地！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />尚不知道术方究竟是何用意，她已乘云而起，飘然而去了……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（获得<ArgBox key=SwordTombInformationName type=string/>……）</color>

6574ae0d-75d4-43a9-8848-07a76e452f97/Eve.en: "No! No!<NL>Although you have destroyed your inner illusions, you did not come from the Realm of Selflessness!<NL>You... you... You came from the Land of Blackstones! Damn it! You... you must leave quickly!"<NL>Huanxin shouts in alarm, her beautiful face pale with terror!
6574ae0d-75d4-43a9-8848-07a76e452f97/Eve.cn: “不对！不对！<NL>你虽除灭了自我迷障，却并非由无我之境而来！<NL>你……你……你是自玄石之境而来！糟了！你……你快走！”<NL>焕心惊声喝道！花容失色！
6574ae0d-75d4-43a9-8848-07a76e452f97/Eve.ru: - Нет, нет!<NL>Хотя вы разрушили свои внутренние иллюзии, вы пришли не из Царства Бескорыстия!<NL>Ты... ты... Ты пришел из Страны Черных камней! Черт возьми! Ты... ты должен быстро уйти!"<NL>Хуаньсинь кричит в тревоге, ее прекрасное лицо бледнеет от ужаса!

a34fa608-46dd-4275-8dc3-4496d5794674/Eve.en: "That is... the blade of the <color=#yellow>Fuyu Sword</color>...<NL>It has been swallowed by this demon... You... cannot defeat it..."<NL>Huanxin struggles to speak as layers of bloody ash surge out from the black stone upon her body...
a34fa608-46dd-4275-8dc3-4496d5794674/Eve.cn: “那是……<color=#yellow>「伏虞剑」</color>的剑刃……<NL>已叫这妖魔……吞吃了下去……你……敌不过它的……”<NL>焕心挣扎道，层层血灰自她身上的玄石之中涌出……
a34fa608-46dd-4275-8dc3-4496d5794674/Eve.ru: - Это так... Клинок из <color=#yellow>Меч Фую</color>...<NL>Он был проглочен этим демоном... Ты... не можешь победить это..."<NL>Хуаньсинь пытается заговорить, когда слои кровавого пепла поднимаются из черного камня на ее теле...

a34fa608-46dd-4275-8dc3-4496d5794674/Opt.en: So... this is... the sword within the demon, and the demon within the sword...
a34fa608-46dd-4275-8dc3-4496d5794674/Opt.cn: 原来……这便是……剑在魔中，魔在剑中……
a34fa608-46dd-4275-8dc3-4496d5794674/Opt.ru: Итак... это так... Меч внутри демона, и демон внутри Меча...

16d749cc-034c-482a-b819-b52d0b19aa6a/Eve.en: "The earth remains intact still, and the sky is clear without any haze. Yet why are there so many fiends that I could never seem to get rid of?<NL>Who are you fiend!? That's right, it doesn't matter if you are a Buddha or a fiend... I must slay you all. I must slay them all..."<NL>As soon as the figure finished, he lunged straight at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> with a loud battle cry!

9bbcb9b3-d9f4-4586-8485-c043a3cde416/Eve.cn: “又是你，<NL>任你来几次也一样，那剑我已舍身取回，你为何还不拿去？<NL>你定是仍在怪我鲁莽，也罢，我便用那剑将你杀了吧……”<NL>莫女幽幽地念道，话音未落，突然直扑向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />！

133f25d4-47e1-4be6-8813-a94b49695f25/Eve.en: "Why are you still lingering here?<NL>The flood is coming, yet you won't take shelter...<NL>I want to save your lives, but you fear me more than the flood—you won't even look at me... sigh..."<NL>The newcomer says sorrowfully, then suddenly turns and, as if turning into a piercing cold wind, attacks <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> head-on!
133f25d4-47e1-4be6-8813-a94b49695f25/Eve.cn: “为何你还在这里停留？<NL>洪水将至，你们却不去避祸……<NL>我欲救你们性命，你们反倒怕我多过于怕洪水，连我的面也不想看到……唉……”<NL>来人悲伤地说着，忽然一个转身，犹如化作一阵刺骨的寒风，迎面向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />袭来！

2621224b-70de-47e8-8f94-6b22970687e3/Eve.en: "You have come again.<NL>Have you found the traces of the Sage?<NL>Or perhaps... are you the Sage?<NL>Let me test whether you possess the talent of a Sage."<NL>The person says with a chuckle. Unexpectedly, before the words even finish, they draw their blade and cleave toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!
2621224b-70de-47e8-8f94-6b22970687e3/Eve.cn: “你又来了，<NL>莫非你已寻得圣人踪迹？<NL>又或者……你就是圣人？<NL>且让我试试你可有圣人之才如何？”<NL>来人嘻笑着说，不料话音未落，已拔刀向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />劈来！

b565cfdd-4555-4cc0-b861-cb9c1ca1f1f1/Eve.en: "Master always taught me: 'To achieve the great Tao, sacrifice the self for righteousness'!<NL>I've given up even my life, yet where is the great Tao?!<NL>Is sacrificing one's life not as good as 'sacrificing the self'?!<NL><NL>Why is that? f791a067-47d6-4580-9c6a-e8a95076be06/Eve.en: "Born knowing all myriads of the world, speaking only heaven's sacred truths.<NL>I offer wise counsel, yet heed it not if you cherish your life.<NL>Should you follow my guidance, sincerity shall I return.<NL>Fear not the petty heavenly rules, for we must not let our fleeting, mortal life pass emptily!"<NL>The figure finished and laughed, then suddenly lunged at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> with her sword!
